# pii-scan-datasets

> Detect columns holding personal data in CSV, TSV and JSONL datasets with checksum-validated detectors and header hints, without printing cell values. Python package `trysac-pii-scan-datasets`, import name `pii_scan_datasets`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
